decisions.reason: This injection pump remains very close to our established pumping and dosing knowledge, so our existing engineering, service and R&D capabilities let us refine it at low organizational cost and make withdrawal unlikely.
The transfer pump line fits directly into our core material-handling architecture and benefits from broad in-house manufacturing and model-based learning, so it is strongly worth retaining.

Flow monitoring is somewhat less central than our classic hardware products, but our system expertise, university-linked learning and strategic push toward interoperable solutions give us enough absorptive capacity to improve and keep it.

This hydraulic two-component spraying system is close to our long-standing coating and spraying competences, so we can absorb market feedback quickly and develop it further without major capability gaps.
